verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot has a built-in agent mode/chat assistant that can edit files, plan and execute tasks autonomously (agent mode, cloud agents, assigning tasks to background agents), well documented in first-party docs and corroborated by community usage reports of chat/agent-style pair programming. Missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on validation specifically of autonomous background agent task delegation (most community evidence covers inline completions, not the newer agent mode).
